content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing the same issue. After syncing the clocks, the time updates correctly. Is the certificate authority found in the [document] file? In the online settings under certificate options, it requests a .lcu file instead of a .crt file, and won't allow updating the root certificate using .crt format. By the way, has anyone else noticed the exploit where you can bypass the password by intentionally entering the wrong password into the communication module and then accessing the controller through the configuration software? Edit: Since I've been moved, I'll clarify my question. I'm trying to connect the controller to AWS cloud using a communication module. When I use my PC's internet, it works perfectly. When I connect through the communication module, I receive the following error message via SMS: ERROR Secure connection to [product_name] BM [version_no] or higher cannot be established, verification of BM certificate failed I've synchronized the controller's clock by setting it as an NTP client and configuring the communication module to forward time, and the time updates on the controller. However, there appears to be a slight delay.
Could you share the diagnostic buffer and firmware version details? The solutions provided earlier should be applicable to your current issue.

Currently, no errors appear, but I still can't access the device using the configuration software unless I enter an incorrect password or change it to [version_no]. Firmware status: module name controller.communicationModule, activated firmware version [version_no], activated on 2022-09-19 13:03:02, bootstrap version [version_no], mobile wireless module version 13.00.106.
Here is what the view looks like when connected.
Could you provide the reference for the [product_name]? And which version of the configuration software are you using?
The device is article number [article_no], firmware version [version_no], and the software version is [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering secure connection problems between [product_name] controllers and AWS cloud using a communication module. Certificate verification issues persist, even after NTP clock synchronization and following standard procedures. There's uncertainty around the required certificate file types for proper configuration. A possible security vulnerability is noted that may allow password bypass, indicating both technical and security concerns.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect secure, seamless connectivity between [product_name] controllers and AWS cloud via communication modules, straightforward certificate management, and precise time synchronization across devices.
